findings.evidence: Exact guide source: `The council plans to bring in clearer quiet-hour rules.` The current boundary says rules must actually be proposed and implemented, while all assessments use already-adopted rules. `Plans to bring in` validly describes an intended future introduction, not enactment already completed.
findings.repair: State that planned future introduction and completed introduction are both valid grammatical frames; distinguish an announced concrete plan from mere consideration and enacted effect. Assess at least one planned-but-not-yet-effective use, preserving completed uses and the exact source form.
